services.goal: Find EC2 waste - instances stopped for long periods still paying for EBS, running instances with very low utilization, and over-provisioned instance types.
approach: List instances with `ec2 describe-instances`; capture type, state, and attached volumes.
For stopped instances, capture how long they have been stopped and the EBS still billing.
Read `CPUUtilization`, network and EBS I/O from CloudWatch; flag sustained low usage.
Prefer Compute Optimizer (`compute-optimizer get-ec2-instance-recommendations`).
services.levers: idle/stopped instances, instance rightsizing, Graviton and Spot candidates

services.goal: Find EKS waste - control planes with no or idle workloads, over-provisioned managed node groups, and Fargate profiles running underutilized pods.
approach: List clusters (`eks list-clusters`, `eks describe-cluster`); each control plane bills hourly even when idle.
List node groups (`eks list-nodegroups`, `eks describe-nodegroup`) and read node CPU/memory from CloudWatch Container Insights.
List Fargate profiles (`eks list-fargate-profiles`) and correlate with pod activity.
Prefer Compute Optimizer for the underlying node groups (`compute-optimizer get-auto-scaling-group-recommendations`).
services.levers: idle control planes, over-provisioned node groups, Graviton/Spot candidates, oversized Fargate pods

services.goal: Find ECS/Fargate waste - services with over-provisioned task CPU/memory, idle services holding desired count above demand, and clusters with no running tasks.
approach: List clusters and services (`ecs list-clusters`, `ecs list-services`, `ecs describe-services`).
Read task `CPUUtilization` and `MemoryUtilization` from CloudWatch against task-definition reservations.
Flag empty clusters and services whose desired count exceeds observed need.
Prefer Compute Optimizer (`compute-optimizer get-ecs-service-recommendations`).
services.levers: oversized task sizing, idle services, Fargate Spot and Graviton candidates

services.goal: Find Lambda waste - functions with no invocations, over-provisioned memory, and provisioned concurrency that sits unused.
approach: List functions (`lambda list-functions`) and provisioned concurrency config.
Read `Invocations`, `Duration` and `MaxMemoryUsed` from CloudWatch; flag idle and over-memory functions.
Flag provisioned concurrency far above observed concurrent executions.
Prefer Compute Optimizer (`compute-optimizer get-lambda-function-recommendations`).
services.levers: idle functions, memory rightsizing, unused provisioned concurrency, Graviton candidates

services.goal: Find Auto Scaling groups that hold more capacity than demand requires, lack dynamic scaling, or sit at a fixed high minimum.
approach: List groups and policies (`autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups`, `autoscaling describe-policies`).
Read group CPU/utilization from CloudWatch; flag high min/desired with low utilization.
Flag groups with no target-tracking or step scaling policy.
Prefer Compute Optimizer (`compute-optimizer get-auto-scaling-group-recommendations`).
services.levers: over-fixed minimum capacity, missing dynamic scaling, Spot mix, rightsizing

services.goal: Find Elastic Beanstalk environments that are idle or over-provisioned, including load-balanced environments serving negligible traffic.
approach: List environments and resources (`elasticbeanstalk describe-environments`, `describe-environment-resources`).
Read underlying EC2/ELB utilization from CloudWatch; flag idle or low-traffic environments.
Flag load-balanced environments that could run single-instance.
services.levers: idle environments, instance rightsizing, unnecessary load balancers

services.goal: Find AWS Batch waste - compute environments holding On-Demand capacity that could be Spot, non-zero minvCpus keeping instances warm, and idle environments.
approach: List compute environments and queues (`batch describe-compute-environments`, `batch describe-job-queues`).
Flag EC2 environments with minvCpus above zero and On-Demand where Spot is viable.
Read instance utilization and job history from CloudWatch to spot idle environments.
services.levers: Spot versus On-Demand, warm minvCpus capacity, idle compute environments

services.goal: Find Lightsail waste - idle instances, unattached static IPs, unused load balancers, and idle managed databases.
approach: List resources (`lightsail get-instances`, `get-relational-databases`, `get-load-balancers`, `get-static-ips`).
Read instance metrics (`lightsail get-instance-metric-data`); flag idle instances.
Flag static IPs not attached to a running instance and load balancers with no traffic.
services.levers: idle instances, detached static IPs, unused load balancers, idle databases

services.goal: Find App Runner waste - services with no traffic still billing for provisioned instances, and over-provisioned CPU/memory.
approach: List services (`apprunner list-services`, `apprunner describe-service`).
Read request and CPU/memory metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle services.
Flag oversized instance configuration relative to observed usage.
services.levers: idle services, CPU/memory rightsizing, pause candidates

services.goal: Find Nitro Enclave waste - parent instances sized for enclaves that are idle or over-allocated on CPU/memory.
approach: Identify enclave-enabled instances (`ec2 describe-instances` with EnclaveOptions).
Read parent-instance utilization from CloudWatch over the window.
Flag over-allocated enclave CPU/memory relative to parent instance size.
services.levers: idle parent instances, enclave CPU/memory allocation

services.goal: Find Outposts waste - unused capacity on the rack or server, and idle EC2/EBS local resources.
approach: List Outposts and assets (`outposts list-outposts`, `outposts list-assets`).
Compare provisioned versus consumed capacity; flag persistent unused capacity.
Read utilization of EC2 instances running on the Outpost from CloudWatch.
services.levers: unused rack capacity, idle local instances and volumes

services.goal: Find S3 waste - buckets with no lifecycle policy, incomplete multipart uploads consuming billable storage, non-current versions accumulating, and cold data that could move to a cheaper storage class.
approach: List buckets and regions (`s3api list-buckets`, `s3api get-bucket-location`).
Check lifecycle config (`s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration`); a no-configuration error is an opportunity.
Find incomplete multipart uploads (`s3api list-multipart-uploads`).
Use S3 Storage Lens or storage class analysis, plus CloudWatch `BucketSizeBytes` and `NumberOfObjects`, to spot cold data and version bloat.
services.levers: missing lifecycle rules, incomplete multipart uploads, non-current versions, Intelligent-Tiering and Glacier candidates

services.goal: Find EBS waste - unattached volumes, over-provisioned IOPS/throughput, gp2 volumes that should be gp3, and volumes attached to long-stopped instances.
approach: List volumes (`ec2 describe-volumes`); flag `available` (unattached) volumes.
Flag gp2 volumes as gp3 migration candidates and io1/io2 with provisioned IOPS above observed use.
Read `VolumeReadOps`/`VolumeWriteOps` and burst balance from CloudWatch.
Prefer Compute Optimizer (`compute-optimizer get-ebs-volume-recommendations`).
services.levers: unattached volumes, gp2 to gp3 migration, over-provisioned IOPS, oversized volumes

services.goal: Find EBS snapshot waste - snapshots older than a retention threshold and orphaned snapshots whose source volume no longer exists.
approach: List owned snapshots (`ec2 describe-snapshots --owner-ids self`) with creation dates.
Compute age and flag snapshots beyond the retention threshold.
Cross-reference `ec2 describe-volumes` to identify orphaned snapshots.
Cross-reference `ec2 describe-images --owners self` for AMI-backing snapshots.
services.levers: aged snapshots, orphaned snapshots, redundant AMI backing snapshots

services.goal: Find EFS waste - file systems without lifecycle management to Infrequent Access, idle or unmounted file systems, and Provisioned Throughput above actual usage.
approach: List file systems and lifecycle config (`efs describe-file-systems`, `efs describe-lifecycle-configuration`).
Flag file systems with no IA/Archive lifecycle policy.
Read `TotalIOBytes` and `ClientConnections` from CloudWatch; flag idle file systems.
Flag Provisioned throughput mode where Bursting or Elastic would cost less.
services.levers: missing IA lifecycle, idle file systems, throughput-mode fit

services.goal: Find FSx waste - over-provisioned storage and throughput capacity, idle file systems, and Multi-AZ deployments where Single-AZ would suffice.
approach: List file systems (`fsx describe-file-systems`) across Lustre, Windows, ONTAP and OpenZFS.
Compare provisioned storage and throughput against CloudWatch usage metrics.
Flag idle file systems and richer-than-needed deployment types.
services.levers: storage and throughput rightsizing, idle file systems, deployment-type review

services.goal: Find AWS Backup waste - recovery points retained beyond policy, orphaned recovery points from deleted resources, and unnecessary cross-region copies.
approach: List vaults and recovery points (`backup list-backup-vaults`, `backup list-recovery-points-by-backup-vault`).
Compare recovery point age against the backup plan retention (`backup list-backup-plans`).
Flag recovery points whose source resource no longer exists.
Review cross-region and cross-account copy jobs for necessity.
services.levers: over-retention, orphaned recovery points, redundant copies, cold storage tiering

services.goal: Find Storage Gateway waste - idle gateways with no I/O and over-provisioned cache or upload buffer.
approach: List gateways, volumes and shares (`storagegateway list-gateways`, `list-volumes`, `list-file-shares`).
Read I/O and cache-hit metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle gateways.
Flag oversized cache and upload buffer relative to usage.
services.levers: idle gateways, cache rightsizing

services.goal: Find S3 Glacier waste - vaults retaining archives past their useful life and retrieval patterns that suit a cheaper tier.
approach: List vaults (`glacier list-vaults`) and inventory metadata.
Flag vaults with very old archives and no documented retention need.
Review retrieval patterns; expedited retrievals cost far more than bulk.
services.levers: archive retention, retrieval-tier selection

services.goal: Find DataSync waste - tasks re-transferring unchanged data and agents left running with no active tasks.
approach: List tasks, locations and agents (`datasync list-tasks`, `list-locations`, `list-agents`).
Review task execution history (`datasync list-task-executions`) for volume transferred.
Flag idle agents and tasks transferring the same data repeatedly.
services.levers: redundant transfers, idle agents, transfer scheduling

services.goal: Find RDS waste across engines - idle instances, over-provisioned instance classes and storage, unnecessary Multi-AZ, and aged manual snapshots.
approach: List instances (`rds describe-db-instances`) with engine, class, storage and Multi-AZ.
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization` and `FreeStorageSpace` from CloudWatch; flag idle and over-provisioned databases.
Flag over-allocated storage and Multi-AZ on non-critical databases.
List manual snapshots (`rds describe-db-snapshots --snapshot-type manual`) and flag aged ones.
services.levers: idle instances, instance and storage rightsizing, Multi-AZ review, aged snapshots, Graviton candidates

services.goal: Find Aurora waste - idle clusters, over-provisioned instances, provisioned clusters that suit Serverless v2, and excess reader replicas.
approach: List clusters and instances (`rds describe-db-clusters`, `rds describe-db-instances`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization` and Serverless capacity from CloudWatch.
Flag spiky or low-usage provisioned clusters as Serverless v2 candidates.
Flag reader replicas carrying little query load.
services.levers: idle clusters, instance rightsizing, Serverless v2 candidates, excess readers

services.goal: Find DynamoDB waste - provisioned tables far above consumed capacity with no autoscaling, capacity-mode mismatches, unused global secondary indexes, and idle global table replicas.
approach: List and describe tables (`dynamodb list-tables`, `dynamodb describe-table`).
For PROVISIONED tables compare provisioned versus consumed capacity from CloudWatch; flag gaps and missing autoscaling.
Flag steady low-traffic tables suiting provisioned and spiky tables suiting on-demand.
Flag GSIs with negligible consumed capacity and idle replicas.
services.levers: capacity-mode fit, provisioned overshoot, missing autoscaling, unused GSIs

services.goal: Find ElastiCache waste - idle Redis or Memcached clusters, over-provisioned node types, excess replicas, and clusters with very low memory usage.
approach: List clusters and replication groups (`elasticache describe-cache-clusters`, `describe-replication-groups`).
Read `CPUUtilization`, memory usage, `CurrConnections` and cache hit metrics from CloudWatch.
Flag idle clusters, oversized node types and unnecessary replica counts.
services.levers: idle clusters, node rightsizing, excess replicas, Graviton candidates

services.goal: Find MemoryDB waste - idle clusters, over-provisioned node types, and excess shard or replica counts.
approach: List clusters (`memorydb describe-clusters`) with node and shard configuration.
Read CPU, memory and connection metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle and oversized clusters.
Flag shard and replica counts above what the workload needs.
services.levers: idle clusters, node rightsizing, excess shards and replicas

services.goal: Find Redshift waste - idle provisioned clusters, pause or Serverless candidates, over-provisioned node counts, and unused Concurrency Scaling.
approach: List clusters and Serverless workgroups (`redshift describe-clusters`, `redshift-serverless list-workgroups`).
Read `CPUUtilization`, `DatabaseConnections` and query activity from CloudWatch.
Flag steady-idle clusters as pause or Serverless candidates and oversized node counts.
services.levers: idle clusters, pause and Serverless candidates, node rightsizing

services.goal: Find DocumentDB waste - idle clusters, over-provisioned instance sizes, and excess replica instances.
approach: List clusters and instances (`docdb describe-db-clusters`, `docdb describe-db-instances`).
Read `DatabaseConnections` and `CPUUtilization` from CloudWatch; flag idle and over-provisioned clusters.
Flag replicas carrying little read load.
services.levers: idle clusters, instance rightsizing, excess replicas

services.goal: Find Neptune waste - idle clusters, over-provisioned instances, and Serverless capacity candidates.
approach: List clusters and instances (`neptune describe-db-clusters`, `neptune describe-db-instances`).
Read `CPUUtilization` and request metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle clusters.
Flag low or spiky usage clusters as Serverless candidates.
services.levers: idle clusters, instance rightsizing, Serverless candidates

services.goal: Find Keyspaces waste - provisioned tables far above consumed capacity and capacity-mode mismatches.
approach: List keyspaces and tables (`keyspaces list-keyspaces`, `list-tables`, `get-table`).
Compare provisioned versus consumed capacity from CloudWatch for provisioned tables.
Flag capacity-mode mismatches and missing autoscaling.
services.levers: capacity-mode fit, provisioned overshoot, missing autoscaling

services.goal: Find Timestream waste - tables with long and expensive memory-store retention that could move to magnetic sooner, and idle databases.
approach: List databases and tables (`timestream-write list-databases`, `list-tables`, `describe-table`).
Review memory-store versus magnetic-store retention; flag long memory retention.
Read ingestion and query metrics from CloudWatch to spot idle tables.
services.levers: memory-store retention tuning, idle tables

services.goal: Find QLDB waste - ledgers with no activity still billing for storage and journal I/O.
approach: List ledgers (`qldb list-ledgers`, `qldb describe-ledger`).
Read journal and storage metrics from CloudWatch; flag inactive ledgers.
Flag ledgers retained after migration away from QLDB.
services.levers: idle ledgers, journal storage growth

services.goal: Find Aurora DSQL waste - clusters with negligible request activity still incurring cost.
approach: List clusters (`dsql list-clusters`, `dsql get-cluster`).
Read request and storage metrics from CloudWatch over the window.
Flag clusters with no meaningful activity.
services.levers: idle clusters, storage growth

services.goal: Find DMS waste - replication instances left running after migrations completed and over-provisioned instance classes.
approach: List replication instances and tasks (`dms describe-replication-instances`, `dms describe-replication-tasks`).
Flag instances whose tasks are all stopped or completed.
Read CPU and memory metrics from CloudWatch; flag over-provisioned classes.
services.levers: post-migration idle instances, instance rightsizing

services.goal: Find Elastic IP waste - addresses with no association, or associated with a stopped instance, both of which incur idle hourly charges.
approach: List addresses (`ec2 describe-addresses`).
Flag addresses with no `AssociationId`.
Cross-reference `ec2 describe-instances` and flag addresses on stopped instances.
services.levers: unassociated addresses, addresses on stopped instances

services.goal: Find NAT Gateway waste - gateways with no traffic still billing hourly, and redundant per-AZ gateways in low-traffic VPCs.
approach: List gateways (`ec2 describe-nat-gateways`).
Read `BytesOutToDestination` and `ActiveConnectionCount` from CloudWatch; flag no-traffic gateways.
Flag multiple gateways in VPCs whose traffic could be served by fewer, and consider VPC endpoints for S3/DynamoDB traffic.
services.levers: idle gateways, redundant AZ coverage, endpoint alternatives for S3/DynamoDB traffic

services.goal: Find load balancer waste - ALB, NLB, GWLB or Classic load balancers with no healthy targets or effectively no traffic.
approach: List load balancers (`elbv2 describe-load-balancers`, `elb describe-load-balancers`).
Check target health (`elbv2 describe-target-health`); flag those with no healthy targets.
Read `RequestCount`, `ActiveFlowCount` and `ProcessedBytes` from CloudWatch; flag near-zero traffic.
Flag idle listeners and unused target groups.
services.levers: idle load balancers, no healthy targets, consolidation candidates

services.goal: Find VPC endpoint waste - interface endpoints with no traffic billing hourly per AZ, and redundant endpoints across subnets or AZs.
approach: List endpoints (`ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints`).
Read per-endpoint traffic from CloudWatch; flag idle interface endpoints.
Flag duplicate endpoints for the same service and over-broad AZ coverage.
Note that Gateway endpoints for S3/DynamoDB are free and may replace interface endpoints.
services.levers: idle interface endpoints, redundant AZ coverage, gateway-endpoint alternatives

services.goal: Find Transit Gateway waste - attachments with negligible traffic still billing hourly, and attachments to deleted or unused VPCs.
approach: List gateways and attachments (`ec2 describe-transit-gateways`, `describe-transit-gateway-attachments`).
Read per-attachment traffic from CloudWatch; flag near-zero traffic.
Flag attachments to unused VPCs and blackhole routes.
services.levers: idle attachments, unused or blackhole attachments

services.goal: Find Direct Connect and VPN waste - VPN connections with tunnels down or no traffic still billing hourly, and idle DX virtual interfaces.
approach: List VPN connections (`ec2 describe-vpn-connections`) and DX connections and VIFs (`directconnect describe-connections`, `describe-virtual-interfaces`).
Read tunnel state and traffic from CloudWatch; flag idle or down VPNs.
Flag DX virtual interfaces with negligible traffic.
services.levers: idle VPN connections, unused DX virtual interfaces

services.goal: Find CloudFront waste - distributions with low cache-hit ratios inflating origin transfer, enabled but idle distributions, and price classes broader than the audience needs.
approach: List distributions (`cloudfront list-distributions`).
Read `Requests`, `BytesDownloaded` and cache-hit-rate metrics from CloudWatch.
Flag low cache-hit distributions, idle distributions and over-broad price classes.
services.levers: cache-hit ratio, idle distributions, price-class fit

services.goal: Find Global Accelerator waste - accelerators with no healthy endpoints or negligible traffic still incurring the fixed hourly charge.
approach: List accelerators, listeners and endpoint groups (`globalaccelerator list-accelerators`, `list-listeners`, `list-endpoint-groups`).
Read traffic and flow metrics from CloudWatch; flag near-zero traffic.
Flag accelerators with no healthy endpoints.
services.levers: idle accelerators, unused endpoint groups

services.goal: Find Route 53 waste - health checks not referenced by any record set, and hosted zones for domains no longer in use.
approach: List hosted zones and health checks (`route53 list-hosted-zones`, `route53 list-health-checks`).
Cross-reference record sets (`route53 list-resource-record-sets`) to find unreferenced health checks.
Flag hosted zones containing only default NS/SOA records as review candidates.
services.levers: orphaned health checks, unused hosted zones

services.goal: Find Route 53 Resolver waste - endpoints billing per IP address per hour with little or no query volume.
approach: List resolver endpoints and rules (`route53resolver list-resolver-endpoints`, `list-resolver-rules`).
Read query volume from CloudWatch or query logging; flag idle endpoints.
Flag endpoints with more IP addresses than needed for resilience.
services.levers: idle resolver endpoints, excess endpoint IP addresses

services.goal: Find Network Firewall waste - firewall endpoints billing hourly per AZ with little traffic, and unused rule groups with reserved capacity.
approach: List firewalls and rule groups (`network-firewall list-firewalls`, `list-rule-groups`).
Read traffic metrics from CloudWatch; flag low-traffic firewall endpoints.
Flag rule groups with allocated capacity far above rules in use.
services.levers: idle firewall endpoints, over-allocated rule-group capacity, AZ coverage

services.goal: Find VPC Lattice waste - service networks and services with negligible request volume still incurring hourly charges.
approach: List service networks and services (`vpc-lattice list-service-networks`, `list-services`, `list-target-groups`).
Read request metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle services.
Flag target groups with no registered or healthy targets.
services.levers: idle service networks and services, unused target groups

services.goal: Find Cloud WAN waste - core network edges and attachments billing hourly with little traffic.
approach: List global and core networks (`networkmanager describe-global-networks`, `list-core-networks`).
List attachments and read traffic from CloudWatch; flag idle attachments.
Flag core network edges in regions with no meaningful traffic.
services.levers: idle attachments, unnecessary core network edges

services.goal: Find endpoint service waste - VPC endpoint services fronted by NLBs that carry no consumer connections.
approach: List endpoint service configurations (`ec2 describe-vpc-endpoint-service-configurations`).
List endpoint connections (`ec2 describe-vpc-endpoint-connections`); flag services with no accepted connections.
Cross-reference the backing NLB for idle traffic.
services.levers: unused endpoint services, idle backing load balancers

services.goal: Find EMR waste - long-running idle clusters, On-Demand core and task groups that could be Spot, and clusters without managed scaling.
approach: List clusters and instance groups (`emr list-clusters --active`, `emr describe-cluster`, `emr list-instance-groups`).
Read YARN and CPU utilization from CloudWatch; flag idle long-running clusters.
Flag On-Demand task groups suiting Spot and clusters without managed scaling.
Consider EMR Serverless for spiky workloads.
services.levers: idle clusters, Spot for task nodes, managed scaling, Serverless candidates

services.goal: Find Glue waste - jobs over-allocated on DPUs or workers, excessive job timeouts, running development endpoints, and crawlers running more often than data changes.
approach: List jobs, dev endpoints and crawlers (`glue list-jobs`, `glue get-job`, `glue get-dev-endpoints`, `glue list-crawlers`).
Review worker type and count against run metrics (`glue get-job-runs` DPUSeconds and execution time).
Flag over-allocated jobs, running dev endpoints and over-frequent crawler schedules.
services.levers: DPU and worker rightsizing, running dev endpoints, crawler frequency, autoscaling

services.goal: Find Athena waste - workgroups with no per-query data-scanned limit, result reuse disabled, and heavy full-scan query patterns that partitioning would reduce.
approach: List workgroups (`athena list-work-groups`, `athena get-work-group`).
Flag workgroups without `BytesScannedCutoffPerQuery` or with result reuse disabled.
Review recent queries (`athena list-query-executions`, `get-query-execution` DataScannedInBytes) for high-scan patterns.
services.levers: per-query scan limits, result reuse, partitioning and compression guidance

services.goal: Find Kinesis waste - provisioned streams with more shards than throughput requires, idle streams, and enhanced fan-out consumers no longer used.
approach: List streams (`kinesis list-streams`, `kinesis describe-stream-summary`).
Compare `IncomingBytes` and `IncomingRecords` against shard count from CloudWatch; flag over-sharded and idle streams.
Flag registered enhanced fan-out consumers with no activity.
Consider on-demand mode for spiky low volume.
services.levers: shard rightsizing, on-demand mode, unused fan-out consumers, idle streams

services.goal: Find Data Firehose waste - delivery streams with no incoming records, and inefficient buffering driving excess S3 PUT and transformation cost.
approach: List delivery streams (`firehose list-delivery-streams`, `firehose describe-delivery-stream`).
Read incoming record and byte metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle streams.
Flag small buffer sizes causing excessive small-object writes and unused format conversion.
services.levers: idle delivery streams, buffer tuning, transformation cost

services.ce: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka
services.goal: Find MSK waste - over-provisioned broker instance types and counts, over-allocated broker storage, and idle clusters.
approach: List clusters (`kafka list-clusters`, `kafka describe-cluster`).
Read broker CPU, disk usage and throughput from CloudWatch; flag over-provisioned brokers and idle clusters.
Flag over-allocated broker storage and consider Serverless for spiky volume.
services.levers: broker rightsizing, storage tuning, Serverless candidates, idle clusters

services.goal: Find OpenSearch waste - over-provisioned data and master node counts and types, no UltraWarm or cold tiering for old indices, and idle domains.
approach: List domains (`opensearch list-domain-names`, `opensearch describe-domain`).
Read CPU, JVM memory, search and index rates and storage from CloudWatch.
Flag over-provisioned and idle domains, and hot-only storage for old indices.
Consider Serverless for spiky workloads.
services.levers: node rightsizing, UltraWarm and cold tiering, idle domains, Graviton candidates

services.goal: Find Managed Flink waste - applications with over-provisioned KPUs and parallelism, and applications left running with no throughput.
approach: List applications (`kinesisanalyticsv2 list-applications`, `describe-application`).
Read KPU utilization and throughput from CloudWatch; flag over-provisioned parallelism.
Flag running applications processing no records.
services.levers: KPU and parallelism rightsizing, idle applications

services.ce: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow
services.goal: Find MWAA waste - environments sized larger than DAG load requires, high minimum worker floors, and environments with negligible DAG activity.
approach: List environments (`mwaa list-environments`, `mwaa get-environment`).
Read scheduler and worker CPU and task metrics from CloudWatch.
Flag oversized environment class, high MinWorkers floors and idle environments.
services.levers: environment-class rightsizing, minimum worker floor, idle environments

services.goal: Find EMR Serverless waste - applications with pre-initialized capacity held warm but rarely used.
approach: List applications (`emr-serverless list-applications`, `get-application`).
Review pre-initialized capacity configuration against job run frequency.
Read job run history and flag warm capacity that is rarely consumed.
services.levers: pre-initialized warm capacity, application idle timeout

services.goal: Find DataZone waste - domains and environments provisioned but not actively used.
approach: List domains and projects (`datazone list-domains`, `list-projects`, `list-environments`).
Flag environments with no recent activity.
Flag domains retained after evaluation ended.
services.levers: idle domains and environments

services.goal: Find Lake Formation waste - storage optimizer and governed table compaction running on tables that do not need it.
approach: List resources and governed tables (`lakeformation list-resources`).
Review automatic compaction and storage optimizer settings.
Flag optimization running on low-change tables.
services.levers: storage optimizer scope, compaction frequency

services.goal: Find FinSpace waste - environments and managed kdb clusters running without active use.
approach: List environments and kdb clusters (`finspace list-environments`, `list-kx-environments`, `list-kx-clusters`).
Flag running clusters with no query activity.
Flag oversized cluster capacity configuration.
services.levers: idle environments and clusters, cluster rightsizing

services.goal: Find Clean Rooms waste - collaborations and configured tables retained after analyses finished, and high query compute usage.
approach: List collaborations and configured tables (`cleanrooms list-collaborations`, `list-configured-tables`).
Review analysis and query history for activity.
Flag idle collaborations and expensive repeated queries.
services.levers: idle collaborations, query compute efficiency

services.goal: Find Entity Resolution waste - matching workflows scheduled more often than data changes.
approach: List matching and ID mapping workflows (`entityresolution list-matching-workflows`).
Review job history and processed record counts.
Flag over-frequent scheduled workflows.
services.levers: workflow frequency, processed record volume

services.goal: Find API Gateway waste - idle APIs still deployed, REST stages with provisioned cache and low hit rates, and simple REST APIs that would be cheaper as HTTP APIs.
approach: List REST and HTTP APIs and stages (`apigateway get-rest-apis`, `apigatewayv2 get-apis`).
Read `Count`, `CacheHitCount` and `CacheMissCount` from CloudWatch; flag idle APIs.
Flag cache-enabled stages with low hit rates and REST-to-HTTP migration candidates.
services.levers: idle APIs, cache review, REST to HTTP API migration

services.goal: Find Step Functions waste - high-volume Standard workflows that would be far cheaper as Express, and idle state machines.
approach: List state machines and types (`stepfunctions list-state-machines`, `describe-state-machine`).
Read execution counts and durations from CloudWatch.
Flag high-volume short-duration Standard workflows as Express candidates and idle state machines.
services.levers: Standard to Express migration, idle state machines, state transition volume

services.goal: Find SQS waste - unused queues still polled by consumers, and short-polling patterns inflating request counts.
approach: List queues and attributes (`sqs list-queues`, `sqs get-queue-attributes`).
Read message sent and received metrics from CloudWatch; flag unused queues.
Flag queues with `ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds` of zero (short polling).
services.levers: unused queues, long-polling adoption, empty-receive request volume

services.goal: Find SNS waste - topics with no publishes, subscriptions to dead endpoints driving retries, and costly SMS delivery patterns.
approach: List topics and subscriptions (`sns list-topics`, `sns list-subscriptions`).
Read publish and delivery-failure metrics from CloudWatch; flag idle topics.
Flag subscriptions with persistent delivery failures and review SMS spend.
services.levers: idle topics, failing subscriptions, SMS delivery cost

services.goal: Find EventBridge waste - rules matching no events, archives with long retention, and schedules firing more often than needed.
approach: List buses, rules and archives (`events list-event-buses`, `list-rules`, `list-archives`).
Read invocation and failed-invocation metrics from CloudWatch; flag rules that never match.
Flag archives with long retention and over-frequent schedules.
services.levers: unmatched rules, archive retention, schedule frequency
